en.title: Syrian Energy Ministry: Rise in Petroleum Product Prices is Temporary to Ensure Supplies
en.summary: Syria's energy ministry stated that increases in petroleum product prices are temporary, with diesel prices approaching 1400 dollars per ton, as the market relies on imports during maintenance of the Banias refinery.

stories.title: S&P affirms Saudi Arabia at A+ with stable outlook

en.title: S&P affirms Saudi Arabia at A+ with stable outlook
en.summary: S&P Global Ratings maintained Saudi Arabia's sovereign credit ratings at A+/A-1 with a stable outlook, citing the kingdom's diversified energy infrastructure and fiscal buffers as protection against regional instability.

en.title: Vanuatu ferry disaster: 1 dead, over 30 missing after ferry sinks in bad weather
en.summary: The MV Matui ferry sank off Vanuatu in adverse weather conditions, leaving one person dead and more than 30 missing, though 15 survivors were rescued. Authorities are examining potential contributing factors including weather and possible overloading.

en.summary: Indonesian rescue teams launched a search operation after the Virgo Transport 8, carrying at least 240 people, lost communication while traveling from Surabaya to South Kalimantan in the Java Sea.

en.summary: The UN reported that more than 2,000 people arrived in Djibouti this week fleeing escalated fighting between Houthi fighters and Yemeni government forces, following a major Houthi offensive that secured control of the Red Sea coast.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia achieved a trade surplus of SAR 61.5 billion in Q2 2026, up 62% annually, driven by higher oil exports despite a decline in non-oil exports.
